details: OpenAI shipped ChatGPT Images 2.5 (Sept 8 2026): better subject/face preservation from reference photos, more precise multi-turn edits, up to 50% faster. A viral prompt thread (Rachel Woods) gives copy-paste prompts people are using to turn selfies into photographer-style portraits. Reel = real feature + the actual prompts viewers can use.
subject: ChatGPT Images 2.5 photo-editing prompts
audience: Phone-first ChatGPT users who already know it can generate images and want to know how to get a photographer-quality result from their own selfie
core_value: Why ChatGPT's edits stopped drifting your face into a stranger, and the actual prompt wording people are using to get photographer-style portraits from it
desired_action: Comment PROMPTS for all nine prompts
tone: Plain, specific, no hype. The prompts do the talking; no claim that OpenAI shipped a 'photographer mode' feature
footage_constraints: ANIMATED TREATMENT: facePlan bookends (presenter on hook + CTA only, HeyGen digital twin driven by ElevenLabs VO slices), `slide`/`stage` motion graphics for the feature claim and mechanism beats (OpenAI logo, no captured screenshot -- X could not be captured headlessly, see STYLE-RULES), and `xpost` cards (real name/handle/verified badge) quoting Rachel Woods' three featured prompts verbatim-paraphrased, full text credited in giveaway.md.
